description: Phase 2H: O2 lower-zone flow — aceptado como opt-in (default OFF). gain=0.25 + guard v4 + phase2h_lower_cf_drain_coeff=0.56 → 10/10 o2_lower PASS. Guard v4: drenaje acelerado de o2_lower via doorway interior solo si outside_open_factor>0.01; sin exterior abierto, lower_entr_scale=0.20 (baseline). Victim FED delta +0.000000, 7 sentinels PASS, room.o2 invariants PASS (11 salas). Riesgo documentado: margen t300=0.0001, constante 4.0 hardcodeada, validado solo en escenario two-room. Default OFF — gap estructural Phase 2A vigente en producción.

single_flag.note: Activates all three Phase 2H flags via the preset shortcut in SimulationEngine._sync_auxiliary_services().

explicit_flags.note: Full 10/10 o2_lower PASS configuration. cf_drain_coeff=0.56 activates two-room drainage (o2_lower floor = max(room.o2, cold_room.o2×0.56) → ~0.095). Required for cfast_2r_r0 checks; sealed/HVAC checks covered by guard_v4 + gain=0.25 without drain.

effect.o2_lower: Protects lower-zone O2 in closed/HVAC rooms, allows moderate depletion after exterior opening, and applies stronger lower-zone mixing for interior doorway fire rooms.
effect.targeted_checks: 10/10 O2 lower PASS: r0 window t350/t420, closed t300/t450, two-room r0 t180/t300/t450, HVAC t180/t300/t450.
effect.default_off: Production default unchanged. Baseline reports are unaffected unless the preset or explicit flags are enabled.

broader_validation.root_cause_resolved: Guard v4 en OxygenExchangeSystem.gd: con phase2h_o2_doorway_two_zone_enabled, el drenaje acelerado de o2_lower via doorway interior solo se activa si outside_open_factor>0.01. Sin ventana exterior abierta, lower_entr_scale=0.20 (baseline). FED regression eliminada.
broader_validation.recommendation: Aceptado opt-in. Preset opt-in oficial, flag OFF por defecto. No rebaseline requerido. Gap estructural Phase 2A sigue vigente en producción.

safety_notes: Default OFF — production invariant. Gap estructural Phase 2A (10 checks) sigue en producción.
Margen mínimo en cfast_2r_r0_t300: 0.0001 sobre tolerancia superior. Cambios en exchange_kg/geometría pueden invalidar calibración.
Constante 4.0 era engineering debt; ahora configurable como phase2h_lower_cf_drain_rate (default 4.0, no-op garantizado).
Mecanismo cf_drain solo validado en escenario two-room. No generalizado a multi-room.

default_production.note: Production default unchanged. Preset must be explicitly opted-in per case.
